Metadata.title: Milcow — B2B Dairy Trading Platform
Metadata.description: Buy raw milk and dairy products by the ton, sign long-term supply contracts and pick up directly from our warehouses.

HomePage.title: Fresh milk, by the ton
HomePage.subtitle: Milcow is a B2B dairy platform for businesses: bulk orders, supply contracts and warehouse pickup in one place.

Footer.tagline: Fresh raw milk and dairy from partner farms in Korea, by the ton. Bulk orders, supply contracts and warehouse pickup in one place.
Footer.ctaText: Tell us the products and quantities you need — our team will send a quote and a delivery schedule.

Hero.text: Milcow is a B2B dairy platform for businesses. Bulk orders, monthly supply contracts and warehouse pickup — all in one place.

About.title: We supply the best dairy products
About.text: Milcow connects partner farms in Korea directly with business buyers. Buy anything from raw milk to cheese, butter and milk powder by the ton, and lock in stable volumes and prices with a monthly supply contract.
About.point1: Buy fresh milk from partner farms directly, by the ton
About.point2: Monthly supply contracts keep your price fixed
About.point3: Pick up or get delivery from 0–4 °C cold-chain warehouses
About.photo2Alt: A glass of milk with cookies and a book

Featured.title: Dairy by the ton
Featured.text: From partner-farm raw milk to cream, butter, cheese, yogurt and milk powder. Prices are per ton, with live stock.
Featured.error: Couldn't load products. Please try again shortly.

HowItWorks.title: From order to pickup in four simple steps
HowItWorks.text: No quote calls, no paper contracts. Pick your products on Milcow, pay online and collect them at the warehouse you choose.
HowItWorks.orderText: Choose products and tons, then the shipping warehouse and how you receive them.
HowItWorks.contractText: Need the same amount every month? Let the AI contract assistant draft it for you.
HowItWorks.paymentText: The amount is verified again on the server, so every payment is safe.
HowItWorks.pickupText: Collect from 0–4 °C cold-chain warehouses with your MC- gate code, or get it delivered.
HowItWorks.photoAlt: Girl holding a glass of milk on a dairy farm

AiSection.title: Ask our AI anything
AiSection.text: Milcow AI answers from our real prices, stock and rules. If it doesn't know, it says so and points you to our team — it never makes things up.
AiSection.feature1Text: It searches products, warehouses and contract rules, then answers only from them.
AiSection.feature2Text: Write "20 tons a month, pickup in Icheon" and get a contract draft with a price.
AiSection.feature3Text: It replies in the language you ask in.

Chat.title: Milcow AI
Chat.welcome: Hi! Ask me anything about prices, minimum orders, contracts or pickup.
Chat.q3: How long can a supply contract be?
Chat.errorBusy: The AI can't answer right now. Please try again shortly.

MapSection.title: Partner farms and cold-chain warehouses
MapSection.text: Milk from five partner farms goes straight to 0–4 °C cold-chain warehouses. Pick the one closest to you for pickup, or get it delivered.
